categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Changes contrib/guix/toolchains.scm and carries the 'Build system' label.
categories.rationale: Fixes a configure failure when running Guix builds with `--system` on a different host architecture under emulation. While native release builds are unaffected and produce identical derivations, resolving `--build` during lowering fixes broken cross-system emulation setups.

categories.name: tools
categories.evidence: Guix release build scripts and toolchain configurations belong to the build category, which explicitly covers Guix reproducible builds.
categories.rationale: Not a standalone developer or operator script; contrib/guix falls under the build system.
